plain_language: Hospitals must post their financial assistance application on their website so patients can apply.

header: Policy Summary Posted (as PDF, or on landing page)
plain_language: Hospitals must post a plain-language summary of their financial assistance policy.
Hospitals must post their full financial assistance policy.
All of a hospital's financial assistance documents should give patients the same, correct information.

header: Primary Service Area boundaries compliant with 2007 guidelines?
plain_language: A hospital's financial assistance must cover patients who live in at least the hospital's county and all neighboring counties (its 'primary service area').
There is no deadline to apply for hospital financial assistance. Patients can apply at any time.
Hospitals cannot consider a patient's assets (savings, property, bank accounts) when deciding financial assistance.

header: No mention of immigration status as a barrier
plain_language: Patients cannot be denied financial assistance because of their immigration status.
Hospitals must use the full New York State Uniform Financial Assistance Application, not their own version.
The application must tell patients who to contact for help with financial assistance.

header: Income & Discount Tables Incuded in Application
plain_language: The application must show the income levels and the discount a patient gets at each level.
Income limits must be based on the current year's Federal Poverty Level guidelines.
Patients with incomes up to 400% of the Federal Poverty Level qualify for financial assistance.

header: Installments capped at 5% of monthly income
plain_language: Monthly payment plans cannot be more than 5% of a patient's gross monthly income.

header: Primary Service Area described in summary?
plain_language: The plain-language summary must say which geographic area the hospital's financial assistance covers.

header: Means of applying for assistance explained
plain_language: The plain-language summary must explain how to apply for financial assistance.

header: Income levels used to determine assistance
plain_language: The plain-language summary must list the income levels used to decide who qualifies.
